key_decisions.decision: Maps original 10:2 and introduces the sealed signatories with the narrator’s title and father.
Follows the read Nebai rather than written Nobai.
Keeps the self-binding curse, oath, walking image, and full instruction categories.
Keeps the exact one-third amount without harmonizing the half-shekel elsewhere.
Retains the source’s firstborn categories; notes redemption of sons rather than rewriting the verse to imply sacrifice.
